en.t: My divided skirt has gotten all twisted around.

units.source_text: 七段说着重新穿好裙裤，灵巧地将带子打上了十字结。

en.t: As Shichidan said this, she put her divided skirt back on properly and deftly tied the cords in a cross knot.

units.source_text: 不多久又上厕所解小手去，然后又回到座位上来。

en.t: Before long she went to the toilet again to relieve herself, then returned once more to her seat.
